limits: Only two permitted powers are tested; the sample-temperature cutoff may terminate 6 W. A transient clearing is insufficient for the target.
probe: Compare 3 W and 6 W with fan off, 50 mL initial water and the specified 20-minute measurements.
relation: A warmer viewing interface can reduce condensation, but base heating also warms water and the sample.

limits: No airflow instrument is available; a setting change cannot establish the transport path alone.
probe: At 3 W, compare fan off with 30% in the marked original orientation; measure readability and temperature over 20 minutes.
relation: Mixing can reduce local humid pockets and distribute heat, while also carrying vapor toward a cool surface.

limits: Capacity and uptake rate are not calibrated; short success cannot establish reusable service life or compatibility with real samples.
probe: Compare fresh 20 g desiccant in a removable dry tray against an empty tray at 3 W, fan off and 50 mL water.
relation: Moisture uptake may lower enclosure humidity and condensation.
